comment: Raw inputs of the globe and region-tile bakes, pinned by SHA-256 and size. Fetch with `cd tools/bake && uv run timefly-fetch --sources ../../data/sources.json --raw ../../data/raw`. Provenance, citations and terms: data/README.md. The PaleoDEM report PDF (data/raw/report/) is reference reading only and is not fetched. `range_read` lists a file that is never downloaded whole: `timefly-bake climate` reads only the chunks it needs by HTTP range requests (data/README.md, Past climate).
